fr_html: Le PRESIDENT ouvre la discussion sur les articles du texte du Comité de rédaction qui restent réservés après les séances du 19 et du 20 juillet.
en_html: The PRESIDENT opened the debate upon the articles of the text of the Drafting Committee which had been reserved and had not been dealt with at the meetings of July 19th and 20th.
